name: power
title: Battery & Power
description: Battery level and time left, and with the optional power watcher, where the power goes: the draw over the last hours, what uses power now and why, and what used the battery today, this week and ever.
author: pal

settings.label: Power watcher state
settings.description: Optional state.json written by the `power` watcher. It adds measured draw, warnings and top consumers; a stale file is ignored.

store.tagline: Battery level, and exactly what is draining it
features: The level, the power source and the time left in one sentence (`Drawing 12 W · 1 h 48 min left`)
With the `power` watcher: six hours of draw as a chart, with charging stretches and the charge level over it
What uses power now: the split between apps, chip and screen, and each process with its watts and why
What used the battery today, over 7 days and all time, in watt-hours and as a share
Battery health, cycle count and temperature at a glance
A bar item that stays hidden while all is well and shows up for a low battery or a heavy draw

screenshots.caption: Now: the level and six hours of draw on the left; the warning, where the watts go and what uses them on the right
Today: what used the battery in watt-hours with each one's share, the screen and the rest explained
7 days: where the week's watt-hours went, the costliest process under the cursor a key away from Processes
On the menu bar: the level, the draw and the warning that made it surface
Hover opens the popover: the level, the last hour's draw, the warning and what uses power now
On sketchybar: the level, draw and warning as one strip

battery.title: Battery
battery.description: Battery level, and the time left once that is the question being asked. Hidden while healthy by its rules: on battery from 50%, on the charger from 20%, unless the power watcher warns or measures a draw of 15 W. Amber at 20%, red at 10% or on a critical warning. Hover shows the popover (the level, the last hour's draw, the warning, what uses power now, today's watt-hours); a click opens the Battery & Power palette.

rules.when: not power.charging and power.level >= 50 and not power.alert and power.draw < 15
rules.description: On battery with plenty left and nothing wrong: nothing to say.

rules.when: power.charging and power.level > 20 and not power.alert
rules.description: On the charger past the low mark: nothing to say.
The power watcher has a warning (a background burn, a high draw).
